description: Source code for handling and translating PDCCH (Physical Downlink Control Channel) PDUs in a 5G NR (New Radio) context, including functions to fill DCI parameters and CORESET configurations, and a conversion function to process FAPI PDU data into internal representations.

methods.name: fill_dci
methods.description: Populates the DCI (Downlink Control Information) parameters of the PDCCH processor PDU based on FAPI PDU data and precoding matrix repository.

methods.name: fill_coreset
methods.description: Fills the CORESET (Control Resource Set) configuration of the PDCCH processor PDU based on FAPI PDU data.

methods.name: convert_pdcch_fapi_to_phy
methods.description: Converts FAPI PDCCH PDU data into internal physical layer representation, filling in CORESET and DCI information.
